billing.description: Your plan, screens and payments. Payments are handled by WallX; invoices are sent to you separately.
billing.noAccessBody: Ask an owner of the organization for billing details.
billing.none: There is no subscription yet. It starts when the organization is approved.

statusHelp.trialing: Everything works during the trial. Contact WallX (Request a change) to choose a paid plan before it ends.
statusHelp.active: Your subscription is paid and active.
statusHelp.past_due: The paid period has ended. Renew within the grace period to avoid interruption; everything still works until then.
statusHelp.restricted: Editing and publishing are paused because the subscription lapsed. Screens keep playing their current content. Contact WallX to renew.
statusHelp.cancelled: The subscription has ended. Screens keep playing their last content; editing and publishing are paused.

billing.requestHelp: WallX billing will contact you to confirm the change and the payment.
billing.requestSent: Request sent. WallX billing will get back to you.
billing.viaReseller: Your plan and screens are provided by {{name}}. Contact them for changes, invoices and payments.

billingBanner.trialEnding: Your free trial ends on {{date}}. Choose a plan to keep editing and publishing.
billingBanner.pastDue: Payment is due. Renew by {{date}} to avoid interruption.
billingBanner.restricted: Your subscription has lapsed: editing and publishing are paused. Screens keep playing their current content.
billingBanner.cancelled: Your subscription has ended: editing and publishing are paused. Screens keep playing their last content.
billingBanner.resellerPastDue: Payment is overdue. Contact {{name}} before {{date}} to keep editing and publishing.
billingBanner.resellerRestricted: Editing and publishing are paused. Your screens keep playing. Contact {{name}} to restore them.

adminBilling.description: Subscriptions of every organization and requests from customers. Payments are recorded here; invoices are issued in the invoicing app.
adminBilling.legacy_one: {{count}} subscription was created before billing existed and is not monitored yet.
adminBilling.legacy_other: {{count}} subscriptions were created before billing existed and are not monitored yet.
adminBilling.noSubscription: This organization has no subscription yet (it is not approved).
adminBilling.orgDescription: Subscription, payments and entitlements. Every change is audited with its reason.
adminBilling.cancelBody: The subscription stays active until {{date}} and then ends without a grace period.
adminBilling.undoCancelBody: The subscription will continue (and need renewal) as normal.
adminBilling.entitlementsHelp: What the organization may use now: plan, screens purchased and any overrides.
adminBilling.overridesHelp: Overrides apply on top of the plan for this organization only (pilots, enterprise deals). Planned features stay off until released.
adminBilling.resolveHelp: Make the change first (plan, screens, payment), then mark the request done. The customer is notified.
adminBilling.voidBody: {{amount}} received on {{date}} will be marked void (e.g. a bounced cheque). The paid-through date is not changed; adjust it separately if needed.
adminBilling.reasonHint: At least 5 characters. Saved in the audit log.
adminBilling.customPriceHint: Leave empty to use the plan price.
adminBilling.paymentHelp: Record money already received. The paid period is extended from the current paid-through date (or from today if it lapsed).
adminBilling.datesHelp: Change the trial end or the paid-through date (goodwill extension, correction after a voided payment). Clear a date to remove it.

adminFeatures.description: Plans, prices and limits, and which features are released. Changes apply to every organization on the plan.
adminFeatures.editWarning: Saving recomputes the entitlements of every organization on this plan. Existing subscription prices are recalculated the next time each subscription is changed.
adminFeatures.planIdHint: Lowercase, e.g. retail-pro. Cannot be changed.
adminFeatures.limitsHint: Empty = unlimited. Screens empty = the number of screens purchased.
adminFeatures.releaseHelp: A feature is usable only when it is released (GA) and in the plan; beta features only when granted to an organization.

releaseEffect.planned: The feature is switched off for every organization.
releaseEffect.beta: Only organizations with an explicit grant can use it.
releaseEffect.ga: Every organization whose plan includes it can use it.
